brief.prompt: An epic, engaging executive film about why physical AI needs inference and evaluation. Show actual Isaac Lab-Arena evidence from PR 463, Token Factory VLM eval and MuJoCo. No executive-showcase reused footage. Use official Nebius branding. Keep the two simulation experiments and their evidence distinct.
brief.audience: C-suite executives evaluating physical AI infrastructure
brief.goal: Make the need for simulation, inference and verifiable evaluation tangible.

title: Before the
real world.
scenes.subtitle: A decision becomes an action.
scenes.narration: In physical AI, every decision becomes an action. Before the real world, put it to the test.

title: A robot moves.
Has it succeeded?
scenes.subtitle: The goal: open the microwave.
scenes.narration: A humanoid reaches for a microwave. It moves. But has it succeeded?

title: Ask the model.
Keep the evidence.
scenes.subtitle: Eight frames. One task. A recorded answer.
labels: ORIGINAL FRAMES SENT TO THE VLM
scenes.narration: Token Factory brings vision into the loop. NPA evaluates eight frames against the task.
scenes.eyebrow: NEBIUS TOKEN FACTORY  ×  NPA VLM EVAL

title: Motion is not task completion.
scenes.subtitle: A VLM judgment, checked against the simulator result.
scenes.narration: MiniMax scores this attempt point one. Below the threshold. Isaac Arena also records failure. The gate holds.

title: Make the next experiment better.
scenes.subtitle: Observe the result. Revise the plan. Test again.
scenes.narration: Turn a failed attempt into evidence for the next decision, while the experiment stays in simulation.

title: Now change
the world.
scenes.subtitle: A separate MuJoCo planning experiment.
scenes.narration: A separate MuJoCo experiment. Qwen plans a route to push the cube.

title: One obstacle.
A different outcome.
scenes.subtitle: The same direct plan, tested in two scenes.
scenes.narration: The plan works in a clear scene. Add one obstacle, and it fails. The same instruction. A different consequence.

title: Give inference
the facts.
scenes.subtitle: Images, measured state and task geometry.
scenes.narration: Seventy centimeters short. Give MiniMax the images, measured state, and obstacle geometry.
source_notes: Visual scoring is a separate signal.

title: Reason.
Revise.
scenes.subtitle: MiniMax returns waypoints around the obstacle.
scenes.narration: MiniMax proposes a route around the obstacle. A scripted controller executes its waypoints in the same physics scene. Then we test again.

title: A new route.
A new test.
scenes.subtitle: Watch the revised plan reach the target.
scenes.narration: The revised plan clears the obstacle and reaches the target. The simulator records its trajectory and final position. Every result remains available to inspect.
scenes.eyebrow: FROM MODEL OUTPUT TO MEASURED OUTCOME

title: Score the outcome. Keep the threshold.
scenes.subtitle: The same task, rubric and model evaluate both MuJoCo rollouts.
labels: NPA VLM EVAL  /  MINIMAX-M3  /  8 FRAMES PER ROLLOUT
scenes.narration: NPA scores the blocked rollout zero, and the revised rollout one. The pass threshold stays at point eight.
scenes.eyebrow: NEBIUS TOKEN FACTORY  /  REAL HOSTED EVALUATION

title: Vision judges.
Physics verifies.
scenes.subtitle: The revised cube is inside the target; measured center error is 3.9 mm.
scenes.narration: Visual judgment agrees with recorded physics. These individual experiments tell us what happened, and what to try next.

title: Choose models for the decision.
scenes.subtitle: Planning. Revision. Visual evaluation.
scenes.narration: Qwen plans. MiniMax revises and evaluates. Every response is retained.

title: Make every result reviewable.
scenes.subtitle: Source footage → model response → evaluation → reproducible film.
labels: NPA STUDIO  /  LOCAL EDITING + CACHED SCENE RENDERS
scenes.narration: Keep the footage, prompts, scores, and hashes. Make the story editable.

title: Build intelligence.
Demand evidence.
scenes.subtitle: Test decisions in simulation. Bring evidence to the real world.
scenes.narration: Build intelligence. Demand evidence. Nebius connects GPU simulation with hosted inference and evaluation. Explore Nebius Physical AI.
